top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Knudsen) recognises one mature, independently replicated achievement running from proglucagon processing and GLP-1 physiology to degradation-resistant long-acting agonists with large randomized evidence in glycaemia, weight, and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. Its three seats rest on the uncontested documented record, whereas Mojsov's priority relative to the Habener group cannot be resolved from the supplied material, so P002 is a close second and clearly better than no award.
